reason: This plugin is best classified as knowledge-management because the evidence shows it is a DeepSeek Harness agent skill that primarily delivers fishing-domain guidance from bundled YAML knowledge files (spot analysis, fish activity, bait/lure guidance) and supports fishing report capture.

summaries.zh: BigFish 是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 钓鱼助手技能，基于内置知识库提供钓点与鱼情分析、饵料/钓法建议，并支持渔获与出钓记录。
summaries.en: BigFish is a DeepSeek Harness AI skill for anglers that uses bundled knowledge data to provide fishing spot and fish-activity analysis, bait/lure recommendations, and catch/outing record support.

capabilities: Provides fishing knowledge-driven analysis for spots and fish activity from bundled domain data
Recommends bait, lures, and techniques based on the same knowledge set
Supports recording fishing catches and outing reports in an agent workflow
